title: The Ride Back
sceneText:
The road back to Maplegate takes forty minutes. The night air is much colder than the day was, and the horse’s breath opens out white in the lantern light.

You go back over the whole evening on the way. Who said what. Who looked at you and at what moment. Why that place at the table was the third one and not the second.

One thing becomes clear to you: that was not a meal.

Tomorrow every single person on the estate will know where you were last night, how long you stayed, and what your face looked like when you got back.
